title: Cataldo & Mason 2018 LPI Contrib. 2106: 354 h of sunlight and 354 h of darkness
quote: A complete lunar day cycle is 354 hours of sunlight and 354 hours of darkness.
note: Duration identity for the CS-8 / NASA full-lunar-night bonus. Zeno/Firefly/NASA Ignition do not print bonus hours. Do not multiply 5 Wt thermal by 354 h as electrical leftover. Not BGM1 flown 5 h.
